svg.text: Failure modes, and what actually happened when they ran

Six ways this system breaks, the mechanism that catches each one, and the measurement it produced. Where nothing has forced a path yet, the diagram says so on its face rather than implying more than was measured.

svg.text: Sources: tests/channel/test_parser_dedupe.py · tests/orchestration/test_ingest_graph.py · tests/config/test_settings.py · infra/stacks/messaging_stack.py · src/repaso/config/models.py · docs/reports/calendar-gaps-2026-08-21.md · docs/reports/seed-sweep-2026-08-20.md

The whole offline suite — 706 tests, about 5 seconds, zero credentials, zero network — is also a cost audit: local mode implements the model interface and raises on any unplanned call, so a leak into a paid API fails the suite rather than the invoice.
